flags.why: This figurative sense describes an agitated or impassioned crowd or atmosphere, rather than an individual's angry manner. [Dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/h%E1%BA%A7m_h%E1%BA%ADp)
flags.fix: agitated; impassioned (of a crowd or atmosphere)

flags.why: Using hầm hập to describe one man storming into a room confuses this sense with hầm hầm. [Dictionary](https/en.wiktionary.org/wiki/h%E1%BA%A7m_h%E1%BA%ADp)
flags.fix: Không khí hầm hập chuẩn bị bãi công. = The atmosphere was charged as preparations were made for a strike.

flags.why: Chiết trung belongs to formal or academic discussion and needs a register warning. [Dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/chiet-trung-tieng-anh-la-gi)
Sơn thủy is a literary term for scenery, so an untagged gloss suggests ordinary conversational usage. [Dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/son-thuy-eunCpicBKHQQ5.html)
Chiến bại retains its formal register when describing a sporting defeat. [Dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/chien-bai-eh9IfxEFWQxH1.html)
